replies.body: No, it isn't. WorldEdit is a plugin/mod and MCedit (correct me if wrong) is an application which edits a minecraft world.

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Both WorldEdit and McEdit are editing programs...
McEdit is free-standing outside of minecraft program where Worldedit is used inside of minecraft as a plugin or mod and used via commands and the use of tools. Mcedit is a GUI driven program where you use the mouse to select blocks and filters to execute commands.Both can edit worlds... Just depends on how you like to work.
